Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses GFP-Trap for affinity purification (AP-MS) to identify SART3 interactors. While the study focuses on arginine methylation (SDMA), the MS analysis was a general AP-MS run with multiple variable modifications enabled in the search engine (including methyl-arginine and diGly), rather than a specific PTM-enrichment workflow like TiO2 or K-GG antibodies.

cell_lines: HEK293T and HeLa cells were maintained at 37°C
Hela cells were transfected with GFP-EV, GFP-SART3(WT), GFP-SART3(Y112A) or GFP-SART3(W377A) plasmids
scope: Whole cell lysates were incubated with GFP-trap agarose for 2 h at 4°C. Then the agarose was washed, and the bound proteins were eluted and separated on polyacrylamide gels for western blot analysis or for LC-MS analysis.
total cell lysates were harvested 48h later and incubated with GFP-Trap beads for IP-MS analysis.
